title: 7AA.1 DIMASSOC DXF emitted-graph closure
scope: Require graph-managed dimension and osnap links to identify actually emitted entities
Keep reference-resolver output final while validating its graph identity
Reject missing, ambiguous, or merely preallocated targets before publication
Preserve standalone low-level writer behavior when no entity graph exists

implementation.summary: DIMASSOC DXF emission now checks each nonzero dimension/osnap target before opening its record transaction. In graph-managed mode, the normal remap must agree with a non-ambiguous, actually-written source binding; resolver output must be the unique output identity of an actually-written entity and is not remapped again. The empty-graph direct writer path retains existing behavior. Generated negative cases verify that rejected records do not append bytes.
implementation.limitations: This covers only currently modeled DXF dimension/osnap references. It does not represent omitted osnap subentity/marker/parameter/point/intersection/xref fields, implement live associative updates, or add DWG DIMASSOC support. Duplicate-output rejection is enforced by the implementation but was not given a separate generated vector in this slice.

commands.result: passed; ASCII/Binary emitted targets, missing dimension/osnap targets, preallocated-but-unwritten target, valid resolver redirect, invalid resolver identity, final-handle readback, and no-publication checks
passed; existing direct low-level DIMASSOC behavior and ASCII/Binary field/remap checks remain intact
